construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation authored for this isolated build

input.sources: 1..100 objects with exactly id, title, text; ids unique; blank text allowed
input.bounds: Query <=2000 characters, label <=200, id <=200, title <=500, each text <=100000, combined text <=1000000; CLI input <=2000000 bytes
input.validation: Shared validate_input for CLI and Python API; required and unknown fields checked; JSON loader rejects duplicate keys and nonstandard numeric constants

shared_schema.success: status ok, schema_version, dataset_label, query, findings, retrieval
shared_schema.finding: rank, exact extractive text, score, matched_terms, citation
shared_schema.citation: source_id, source_title, start (inclusive), end (exclusive), quote; offsets are Unicode Python-string indices into the unmodified source text
shared_schema.error: status error, schema_version, error message; CLI exit 2

cross_stage_handoffs: Validated request -> physical-line passage retrieval -> ranked exact extractive findings -> shared JSON output; one research functionality, no external stages

behavior.retrieval: Nonblank physical lines are passages, with surrounding whitespace excluded from citation spans. Unique Unicode word tokens are casefolded; any exact query-token overlap qualifies.
behavior.ranking: Descending number of distinct matched query terms, then original source order, then passage offset. Score is matched distinct terms divided by total distinct query terms, rounded to six decimals.
behavior.extraction: Finding text equals the complete retrieved passage and citation quote; no generated claims or implied factual verification.
behavior.no_matches: Successful empty findings with retrieval.no_matches true
behavior.fixture_label: All supplied example content and test fixtures are synthetic.

test_outcomes.cli: passed: one JSON object, status ok, three exactly cited findings
